idea: note-taking app with better offline sync

The mobile app stutters badly once a page has more than a few hundred lines.
Paying $10 a month for what's basically a glorified wiki is highway robbery.
I genuinely love the database views, no complaints there.
Tried to draft a doc on the subway and lost half of it when I got back to wifi. Never again.
Sync between my laptop and phone is a nightmare. Obsidian Sync is extra money on top.
Long markdown files chug on iPhone. Scrolling jumps everywhere.
Plugin ecosystem is the best part of Obsidian, hands down.
Edited a note on the train, came back to wifi, and the conflict resolver kept the wrong copy.

Sync is broken half the time. iCloud just gives up.
Beautiful editor, but the iPad version slows to a crawl on a note over a few thousand words.

Pro subscription is way overpriced for what you get.
Tag system is unmatched, love it.
Crashes on launch ever since the last update.

Mobile app feels like molasses on anything longer than a single page.

Web clipper is honestly still the killer feature.
